Use case: identity-preserve. Production whole-figure PIXEL ART walk sheet for the established native64 square-grid roguelike.
Input 1: exact identity, anatomy, proportions and MATERIAL COLOR MASTER. Input 2: different cultist used ONLY for walking timing and native game camera. Never copy its hood, robe or costume.
Preserve master color values, warm beige skin shadows, original dark metals, existing orange cloth or ridge. No lighter skin, pink/white recolor, glow, added rim light, polish or stronger highlights. Same illumination at idle and walking.
Layout: EXACTLY 3 columns by 3 rows of equal square cells. Eight DISTINCT walking poses in cells 1–8, row-major. Cell 9 relaxed idle. EVERY figure whole, centered in its cell with generous transparent margins; no clipping or intercell overlap. Constant rigid body size, same zoom and camera for all cells.
Motion: one two-step cycle, 400ms per step / 800ms total. 1 left foot reaches contact; 2 weight settles onto left support, right heel lifts; 3 right foot passes CLOSE below hips with LOW knee lift; 4 right foot reaches next contact; 5 opposite/right contact; 6 weight settles onto right, left heel lifts; 7 left passes close underneath hips; 8 left reaches next contact ready to repeat 1. Modest grounded stride. No wide lateral splaying, skating, kicking, high knees, alternating whole-body zoom or marching dance. Head, torso, arms and equipment move as one coherent connected figure, very little head bob. Both foot soles meet the same ground plane. Preserve natural weight and posture.
Style: exactly the master's dark sharp native game pixel art; deliberate readable pixel clusters and crisp outlines. No smooth painting, airbrush, blur, grain, 3D rendering, glossy recolor or photographic texture. No extra lights or VFX.
Background: genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha zero, including limb gaps. NO floor, painted shadow, matte, checkerboard, grid, border, lettering, labels or watermarks.
Subject: The exact low hunched possessed creature in input 1: pale beige sinewy bare shoulders and long clawed arms, orange-red raised hair/dorsal ridge, long pale bone-like strips draped over a dark lowered face, compact black/charcoal torn pants and dark feet. It has TWO bent walking legs, TWO arms and a permanent forward hunch. Keep its low short torso and crouched silhouette. Do not make it upright, muscular, four-legged, hooded or winged. Hands may hang near the ground but do not serve as four-legged supports. No new weapons or armor.
Direction: True FRONT view walking SOUTH/DOWN toward viewer, same slightly elevated native game projection throughout all eight cells.
